School partnerships

We bring basketball to your school. Our coaches collect the children, run the session and bring them back. Parents arrange nothing, and the school does not need to staff it.

Email us about your school How a partnership starts

Why schools work with us

Plenty of children would love basketball and never get near it. The club is across town and training starts before a parent gets off work.

So we come to the school. Our coaches collect the children from the school door, run the session and bring them back. The children get the same coaches and the same method as our own club teams. Those who catch the bug can carry on into our club teams and camps.

Strandvejsskolen

When we started running sessions at Strandvejsskolen on Østerbro, the program filled to forty children with five more waiting. Over the same spring our under-13 group went from a handful of players to more than thirty.

Schools we work with

Since 2025, Østerbro

Strandvejsskolen

Strandvejsskolen is the home of our Mini and Junior programs. Training runs in the school gym at Sionsgade 1, so the children stay in the building they already know.

We also run sessions with the school's SFO, and our coaches collect the children from SFO before training. This is where the model started.

From September 2026

ISH, International School of Hellerup

ISH High School trains Thursdays, 17:00 to 19:00 at Svanemøllehallen, alongside our own U15 and U17 squads. English on the floor, professional coaches, and more training days for anyone who wants them.

Our ISH Primary School programme is being re-planned for 26/27. We publish the new day and venue once it is locked. Email coach@talatabasketball.dk to hear first.

ISH High School

2019 to 2024, Vilnius, Lithuania

The British School of Vilnius

Before Talata was a club in Copenhagen it was a basketball programme inside a school in Lithuania. Deng was head of the academy at The British School of Vilnius and built the programme there from nothing over five years.

It started with the youngest children and grew year by year up to the mid-teens. Lessons, team practices, exhibitions, league fixtures and competitions against other schools. The signed agreements run through to 2024.

The school has since moved to a new campus and the programme runs well without us. We are on good terms and the door is open. If a school elsewhere wants a basketball programme built from the ground up, this is our blueprint.

Meet the coaches

Program partner

DGI

Our school trainings run in collaboration with DGI. Their support lets us put qualified coaches into schools without asking the schools to fund it.

How a partnership starts

  1. You get in touch. An email is enough. Tell us the school, the ages and roughly how many children.
  2. We come and see the space. We look at the gym or hall and work out what fits your timetable.
  3. We agree a day, a time and a coach, including how pickup and return work, so parents have nothing to arrange.
  4. We run a taster. The children try it before anyone commits to a season.
  5. The program runs. Weekly sessions, and a route into the club for anyone who wants to keep going.

Contact

We are building more school partnerships in Copenhagen for the coming year. If you want basketball at your school, write to us and we come and talk about it.
